style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 2m Pre Lit Mistletoe and Eucalyptus Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Add a traditional note to your festive display with this Pre- lit Mistletoe and Eucalyptus Garland.</p><p>Featuring 50 warm white micro LEDs, wound through a natural twig frame, and decorated with white mistletoe berries, this garland would perfectly complement neutral or traditional decor alike.</p><p>Run this garland along a staircase, or place it on a mantlepiece to add some greenery to your interior during the darker months.</p><p>For illumination, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the attached battery box. Set the handy 6-hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Size: ONE.</p>
